purpose: Private IDisplayManager transactions used by display-mirror-probe/display-mirror-dump to mirror the default display into the encoder input surface. Valid for this exact build only; this vendor shifts AOSP transaction codes, so no other build may reuse these ordinals.

execution.note: Executed only on the pinned build. Not executed on the API 34 x86_64 reference emulator or any other profile.

gate: API 36 AND aarch64 AND effective uid 2000 AND exact ro.build.fingerprint; otherwise unsupported_profile and no library is opened and no Binder call is made.

aosp_reference.note: NOT applicable to this build: the vendor inserts six methods before these, shifting both codes by +6. AOSP ordinals are never used as a fallback.

create_virtual_display.permission: android.permission.CAPTURE_VIDEO_OUTPUT (held by shell) for AUTO_MIRROR without a MediaProjection

request_after_interface_token.encoding: i32 UTF-8 byte length, bytes + NUL, zero-padded to 4 bytes; emitted as little-endian i32 words

request_after_interface_token.meaning: String16 name, i32 isSingleBuffered=0, 'bque' magic, producer Binder, control handle (docs/compat/surface-parcel.json)
callback; also the key of the display in the service

reply_handling.other exception code: remote_exception with the numeric code; the message is never read out
reply_handling.displayId < 0: display_refused (the service answers -1 silently on limits)
reply_handling.displayId == 0: default_display_returned (request was not read as pinned); released immediately

release_virtual_display.guard: Owed from just before the create transaction is sent; sent exactly once on every exit path, including errors and unwinding. Releasing a callback the service does not know is a no-op.

callback.handling: counted with atomics; other callers get STATUS_PERMISSION_DENIED (-1), other codes STATUS_UNKNOWN_TRANSACTION (-74); parcels are never read

server_facts: The display is keyed by the callback Binder and the service links to its death: if the process dies the display is destroyed.
A malformed Surface is not rejected: the service silently reads whatever follows, so field order matters more than error handling.

process_requirements.binder_thread_pool: Started and owned by the executable before the transaction (crate::binder::pool), 4 kernel-spawned workers plus the startThreadPool worker. The encoder's graphic buffer producer is a local Binder, so system_server and SurfaceFlinger call into this process.
process_requirements.lifetime: Function tables, Binder class metadata and the pool live for the process.

limits.packet_and_stream_bounds: those of the synthetic encoder Collector

pass_condition: display created (id > 0) AND released AND at least one coded frame AND SPS >= 1 AND PPS >= 1 AND IDR >= 1 AND no error
known_limits: Secure windows (FLAG_SECURE, DRM) are composed blank.
No frames are produced while the screen is off; an idle screen may produce a single frame.
The 360x640 preset does not match the panel aspect ratio; the mirror is letterboxed by the compositor.
Native String8/String16/strong-Binder encodings and the interface-token header are assumed from AOSP libbinder; they were not read from this device's shared objects.
The synchronous transactions cannot be cancelled; the bounded host session is the backstop.
No streaming protocol: video_available stays false.
